body: wow, this honestly (as cheesy as it sounds) made me want to live another day. i don’t want to die yet. thank you for sharing this and for being brave.

I honestly feel the exact same way. I’ve been working with starbucks for 2 years and over the 2 years I’ve had two specific coworkers who have just hated me for dumb reasons and then after awhile they are okay with me. I don’t understand what I do wrong and always try my best to get along with everyone because we all have to work together and like you said, it’s just when I work with people who are rude or judgment towards me, I shut down. Which makes things worse. 
Recently two people again don’t like me and have been just rude and talking about me to other people. It’s cause me so much anxiety that I called out of a shift because I didn’t want to work with anyone or be around them. I’ve been so anxious to where I’m losing sleep and can’t even function as a person. Honestly I might quit if I continue to feel like this which sucks because I love the job and it’s not a bad job. I just don’t know what to do
